studies.title: All source tissues
studies.note: One independent right-knee specimen. Long bones remain whole; the initial camera is centred on the joint.

studies.title: Cruciate ligaments
studies.note: Femur and extensor tissues are hidden to expose the source ACL and PCL. Restore the femur to compare its original position; this is not a surgical approach.

studies.title: Collateral ligaments
studies.note: Compare the source MCL and LCL with the bones. Select a ligament and fade the others to see its surface.

studies.title: Cartilage & menisci
studies.note: Bones are hidden. Menisci and tibial cartilage each remain one source group; individual medial/lateral parts are not separately labelled.

studies.title: Extensor tissues
studies.note: Compare the source quadriceps tendon, patella and patellar ligament. The quadriceps muscle group is not included in this specimen view.

studies.title: Posterior tissues
studies.note: Inspect the supplied posterior surfaces. This is not a complete popliteal-fossa dissection: nerves, vessels and capsule are absent.

source.credit: Jeevaraaj N Vivekanandan and Juliana Binti Usman, Universiti Malaya, 2026. DOI:10.22452/RD/5T6TZ7, version 1.2.

surfaces.name: Pelvic bone surface (source group)
surfaces.coverageNote: Original pelvic surface kept as one source group; no separate ilium, ischium, pubis or sacral identities are inferred.

studies.title: All regional tissues
studies.note: All supplied hip/thigh surfaces with whole-bone context. This is one source specimen, not complete hip anatomy.

studies.title: Gluteal muscles
studies.note: Set gluteus maximus aside to compare the deeper supplied surfaces. No sciatic nerve or fascia is reconstructed.

studies.title: Deep hip rotators
studies.note: Superficial muscles are hidden. Compare the supplied short-rotator surfaces; nerves, bursae and tendon footprints are not mapped.

studies.title: Iliacus & psoas
studies.note: Inspect the separate source iliacus and psoas major. Lumbar vertebrae and the lumbar plexus are not included.

studies.title: Quadriceps group
studies.note: Four source quadriceps muscles with the supplied extensor tissues. Set rectus femoris aside to expose vastus intermedius.

studies.title: Medial thigh muscles
studies.note: Set superficial source surfaces aside to inspect deeper ones. Small disconnected source fragments remain; they are not named accessory muscles.

studies.title: Posterior thigh muscles
studies.note: Both biceps femoris heads remain separate selections. The other posterior thigh muscles and bony context retain their source positions.

studies.title: Femoral head cartilage
studies.note: Only the supplied femoral cartilage surface is shown. Acetabular cartilage, labrum and capsule are absent, not inferred.

source.credit: Jeevaraaj N Vivekanandan and Juliana Binti Usman, Universiti Malaya, 2026. DOI:10.22452/RD/5T6TZ7, version 1.2.

studies.title: All regional tissues
studies.note: Supplied calf surfaces and whole-bone context. Thin tendons and muscle boundaries retain source limitations.

studies.title: Anterior calf muscles
studies.note: The supplied anterior muscles are visible. Fibularis tertius, retinacula and the anterior neurovascular bundle are absent.

studies.title: Superficial posterior calf
studies.note: Set either gastrocnemius head aside to expose soleus. The source calcaneal tendon is retained; plantaris is not supplied.

studies.title: Deep posterior calf
studies.note: Compare supplied deep posterior surfaces. This is not a tarsal-tunnel or neurovascular dissection.

studies.title: Fibularis longus
studies.note: The source fibularis (peroneus) longus is supplied; fibularis brevis is not. Do not infer a complete lateral compartment.

source.credit: Jeevaraaj N Vivekanandan and Juliana Binti Usman, Universiti Malaya, 2026. DOI:10.22452/RD/5T6TZ7, version 1.2.

surfaces.name: Foot bone group (source: Phalanges)
surfaces.coverageNote: Original grouped foot-bone surface. Individual digit/bone identities are not adjudicated; no metatarsal, phalanx or digit numbering is inferred.

studies.title: All regional tissues
studies.note: Whole source structures are retained. Close-up centres on the foot; use Frame to inspect the full selected long muscle or bone.

studies.title: Source foot bones
studies.note: Tarsal surfaces are separate. The source Phalanges surface remains one grouped entry, without individual digit or bone numbering.

studies.title: Supplied plantar muscles
studies.note: Set flexor digitorum brevis aside to compare quadratus plantae. This is partial plantar anatomy, not complete four-layer dissection.

studies.title: Dorsal muscle surface
studies.note: Extensor digitorum brevis is one source selection. No separate extensor hallucis brevis subdivision is invented.

studies.title: Anterior ankle tendons
studies.note: Follow the supplied whole muscle/tendon surfaces toward the ankle. Retinacula and insertion footprints are not mapped.

studies.title: Calcaneal tendon
studies.note: Compare the original calcaneal tendon surface with calcaneus. Small source fragments/edge contacts are retained; no rupture or repair is modelled.
